text:
On 15 October 2026, on the sidelines of the IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, Development Reimagined and China Chengxin International Credit Rating (CCXI) hosted a fireside chat titled “Rethinking African risk amid new dynamics in China–Africa cooperation: Insights from a Chinese credit-rating perspective.” The conversation drew on CCXI’s Africa Regional Risk Outlook and examined how African sovereign and investment risks are assessed from a Chinese country-risk perspective, as well as how deepening trade, investment and financing ties with China, including the growing use of the Renminbi (RMB), are shaping the cost and availability of capital for African economies.
Ms Zhang Tingting , Managing Director, Sovereign and International Rating at China Chengxin International Rating (CCXI), participated in the fireside conversation with Ms Hannah Wanjie Ryder , Chief Executive Officer of Development Reimagined, who moderated the discussion.
